liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Hey Little One**: back after 116 archived shows (1015 days); rare: 7 archived performances [15]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Truckin', Uncle John's Band, It Must Have Been the Roses, Sunrise [15]

## The recordings

- **gd69-05-10.sbd.tzuriel.1336.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 15 songs; 140 min; rated 3.29/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Digital noise appears around the 18-minute mark as the band starts blasting off; The performance sparkles and shines throughout its twenty minutes of duration; Lovely performance despite nasty sound deterioration occurring in the latter part [3][8][9][11][14]
- **gd1969-05-10.132812.sbd.bear.wise.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 107 min; rated 2/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Left channel suffers degradation from 10:32 until the cut in Turn On Your Love Light [2]

## Around the show

- Listener confirms no Donna vocals, ruling out a stray show with that lineup [5]
- Two power outages hinder the show's start, though the final four songs roll well [10]
- Jerry's voice sounds like 1967/68, suggesting the track is from the early years [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-05-10.sbd.tzuriel.1336.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Tzuriel Kastel; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Transfer path: mC to C to DAT to Sonic Solutions to CDR via Ben Yerys [1]
- **gd1969-05-10.132812.sbd.bear.wise.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by SIRMick; source: Cassette Master (Recorded By Bear on a Concord F-400 Cassette Deck) - Cassette (Ampex C-90) Playback Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No Dolby - Panasonic… [2]. Also: Uploader used iZotope to copy, paste, and adjust levels to fix tape issues [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [May 10, 1969, Rose Palace, Pasadena, CA: Farewell Cream movie/Grateful Dead/Kaleidoscope](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2011/10/may-10-1969-rose-palace-pasadena-ca.html) [16]
